item.title: I Gave My CI a Tamagotchi
item.description: Meta open-sourced the Muse gadget SDK, and my Arduino UNO Q had an 8x13 LED matrix doing nothing but blink boot codes. Now a pixel creature lives there: it hops when CI goes green, sulks when a deploy fails, dozes when the board runs hot.
